issues: 调试标题 PARTICLE SAND FILL + 卡内两根灰骨架条，2px 灰边卡片，没有坐标、类目和单位
高柱的雨从卡片外面落进来，颗粒穿过卡片上沿和标题，穿帮
灰柱里随机混 18% 琥珀颗粒，颗粒中灰 #8f8f8d 又和实体柱浅灰不同色，交接时颜色跳变
“凝成实体”只是粒子面整体淡出 + 实体柱淡入，读作叠化而非凝结；坠落颗粒是静止方块，看不出加速度
changes: 导出 PARTICLE_SAND_FILL_DURATION = 150；出版级图表卡：New signups by region / Q3 2026 · thousands，100/200/300 网格 + 基线 + North/West/South/East 类目，柔光亮场 + 颗粒
雨帘裁进卡片并在绘图区上沿 90px 内渐隐出现；坠落、15% 回弹、6f 柱间错峰与闭式落点全部保留
颗粒与实体柱同色系：灰柱冷灰、主角柱琥珀，逐颗 ±明度微差；坠落中按速度纵向拉长最多 1.75× 读出加速度
真凝结：堆满后颗粒间隙 2px→0、圆角 2.5→0（9f in-out），再由带受光渐变 + 顶部内高光的实体柱接管；数值标签 overshoot 上浮弹出
issuesEn: Debug title PARTICLE SAND FILL, two grey skeleton bars in the card, 2px grey border, and no axis, categories or units
Rain for the tall bars fell in from outside the card, crossing its top edge and the title
Grey bars had 18% random amber grains, and the mid-grey grains did not match the light-grey solid bars, so the colour jumped at handoff
'Condensing into a solid' was just the grain layer fading out under a fading-in bar, reading as a dissolve; falling grains were static squares with no sense of acceleration
changesEn: Exported PARTICLE_SAND_FILL_DURATION = 150; publication-grade chart card with New signups by region / Q3 2026 · thousands, 100/200/300 gridlines, baseline and North/West/South/East categories on a soft-lit backdrop with grain
Rain is clipped to the card and fades in within 90px below the plot top; gravity, 15% bounce, 6f bar stagger and closed-form landing all kept
Grains share the bar palette (cool grey, amber for the hero bar) with small per-grain lightness variation, and stretch vertically up to 1.75× by fall speed
Real condensation: once full, grain gaps close 2px→0 and corners square off over 9f, then a lit gradient bar with top highlight takes over; value labels pop up with overshoot
